meta.title: Holiday House Antica – Vidovići, Island of Cres, Croatia
meta.description: Renovated stone holiday house for 6 guests in Vidovići on the island of Cres: 2 apartments, 3 bedrooms, sea-view balcony, yard and terrace. Peace, nature and a view over the Kvarner.

hero.subtitle: A stone house renovated in 2021, in peace and quiet 280 m above the Kvarner sea.
hero.image_alt: View from Vidovići over the bay and the islands of the Lošinj archipelago

about.title: One of the oldest houses in Vidovići, lovingly restored
paragraphs: Holiday House Antica is one of the oldest houses in the village of Vidovići on the island of Cres. Renovated in 2021, it offers about 145 m² over a ground floor and three upper floors, with stone walls, wooden beams and green shutters that keep the spirit of old island architecture.

The house consists of two apartments with separate entrances – ideal for two families or friends travelling together. Together they offer 3 bedrooms for 6 guests, two fully equipped kitchens, two dining areas, two living rooms and two bathrooms.
In front of the entrance there is a yard and a small terrace with seating for six, and from the balcony on the third floor you can enjoy a beautiful view of the Kvarner Gulf and the Adriatic Sea.

location.title: Peace, silence and a view over the Kvarner
paragraphs: Vidovići lies 280 m above sea level, surrounded by the scent of Mediterranean herbs, silence and unspoilt nature. From the village you have a panoramic view of the bay, of Osoršćica – the highest peak of the island of Lošinj – of the many small islands of the Lošinj archipelago and of the village of Martinšćica.
Cres is reached by ferry from Istria (Brestova – Porozina) or from the island of Krk (Valbiska – Merag); the crossing takes about 25 minutes.
